requests.name: m_crust_soften_brush_lift
requests.why: 육아_25 🚨 제품 작동 칸 오른쪽(31.91~44.52초 '떼지 말고 불려서 들뜨게 … 아기 두피 브러시로 살살 문질러 … 부드러운 솔이 불은 딱지를 상처 없이 조금씩 들어 올려 주거든요', 12.6초). 기름에 붙잡혀 두피 겉에 눌어붙은 노란 딱지가 거품에 불어 가장자리가 들뜨고, 부드러운 솔끝이 지나갈 때마다 조금씩 들려 떨어져 나가며 그 밑 피부는 갈라지지 않고 매끈하게 남는다. ⚠️ 근거(research)는 '불린 딱지를 손톱 없이 들어 올림'까지라 한 번에 다 벗겨지거나 병이 낫는 그림은 그리지 않는다 — 조금씩 들림까지. 색인 전수 확인 — m_scalp_flakes_shed(각질이 저절로 떨어져 검은 옷감에 쌓임, 브러시 없음)·m_plug_loosen_open(모공 마개)·m_soft_brush_glide(치아 잇몸선)뿐, 두피 딱지를 솔로 들어 올리는 장면이 없다. 손·사람·아기 없이 두피 블록과 브러시 머리만(아기 단어 없음 — Flow 미성년자 필터 무관). 범용으로 — 요람딱지·두피 각질·비듬 브러시·각질 불려 떼기 편.

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. 0-3s: from the very first frame a soft layer of white foam settles over the scalp surface, and the amber crust plates under it slowly swell and soften, their edges curling up and loosening from the skin, while the camera dives fast down toward them. 3-6s: the rounded head of a small soft brush with short very fine flexible bristles sweeps in from the side on its own and passes gently over the surface in slow small circles; each time the soft bristle tips pass, a loosened crust plate lifts off in a few pieces and is carried away in the foam, the bristles bending softly and never scraping. 6-8s: the camera races low along the surface as the brush moves off, showing smooth intact pale cyan skin where the crusts were, with no cracks and no tears, only a few small amber pieces still loosely sitting at the far edge, holding until the very last frame. Style lock: every structure stays rendered as the same translucent pale cyan glass with softly glowing edges in the dark slate blue-grey void from the first frame to the very last; the scene never turns opaque, matte, mint green, beige, illustrated or photorealistic. No human figure, no hand, no face anywhere in the frame; the brush head moves on its own. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. Low ambient synth hum with soft foam fizz and a gentle bristle swish, no music, no dialogue.
